en.title: From Arrowverse Villain to Crystal Lake: William Catlett's Fiery Turn
en.summary: Before stepping into the chilling woods of Camp Crystal Lake, actor William Catlett delivered a powerful performance as a formidable villain in The CW's Arrowverse. Fans are taking note of his transition from a community protector with a dark side to a key figure in the upcoming Friday the 13th prequel.
en.body:
Fans of the Arrowverse might recognize a familiar, formidable presence now heading to the ominous **Crystal Lake**. **William Catlett**, who is set to star as Police Chief Levon Brooks in the upcoming Friday the 13th prequel series, previously made his mark on The CW's superhero landscape.

Catlett’s breakout role in the Arrowverse came on the series **Black Lightning** (2018-2021). There, he portrayed a high school principal who wielded impressive lightning powers. While his abilities were ostensibly used to safeguard his community, the character often navigated a morally gray area, showcasing a complex and *vicious* side that resonated with viewers. This duality made his performance a standout, hinting at the depth he could bring to darker, more intense roles.

## From Freeland to Crystal Lake

The transition from the vibrant, albeit troubled, community of Freeland in **Black Lightning** to the notoriously cursed Camp Crystal Lake marks a significant career move for **William Catlett**. In **Crystal Lake**, he steps into the shoes of Police Chief Levon Brooks, a character who will undoubtedly be central to uncovering the dark secrets of the infamous summer camp. The series, developed and showrun by **Brad Kane** and produced by A24, promises to explore the early days of the ill-fated camp, setting the stage for Jason Voorhees's terrifying legacy. With **Linda Cardellini** also attached as Pamela Voorhees, the prequel is already generating significant buzz among horror aficionados.

## Fan Anticipation Builds

Viewers who followed Catlett's work on **Black Lightning** are particularly excited to see him tackle a role in the iconic Friday the 13th universe. The contrast between his heroic-adjacent, yet morally complex, character in the Arrowverse and the potentially more overtly menacing role in **Crystal Lake** offers a compelling narrative arc. Fans are discussing on social media how his intense portrayal in **Black Lightning** proves he has the gravitas to inhabit the world of **Crystal Lake**, with many anticipating his contributions to the lore of one of horror's most enduring franchises. The anticipation is palpable for this prequel, which aims to delve deep into the origins of the terror.

## What's Next

While specific release dates for **Crystal Lake** have not yet been announced, the series is slated to premiere on Peacock. Fans can look forward to **William Catlett** bringing his powerful screen presence to a brand-new chapter of the Friday the 13th saga.
